scope: CT offline quantitative generalization; new acquisition is model-held-out but known in historical project metadata; grouped re-training CV is separately retrospective

matches.round_count_reference: historical parser only; not independent public-score evidence
historical parser only; not independent public-score evidence

comparison: same frozen primary linear and five-seed graph controls, no tuning; report new event separately from v3; engine clock and prior-parser round totals checked
timing_audit: sample freeze+0..20 seconds; game_time offset error <=1/64 seconds, unchanged accumulated paused ticks, not paused/warmup, totalRoundsPlayed==round_number-1; retain failures and report strict subset separately
uncertainty: paired equal-series bootstrap with seed20261023 and 2000 resamples; descriptive intervals only, explicitly report series count
retrieval: Dust2 train candidates only; common observation vs static/GRU embeddings, top5, leave match identities out of inputs; no human qrels => no tactical Recall/nDCG claims
source_audit: exact content duplicate detection across splits; canonical team-pair aliases flagged, not assumed to be same series
integration: real backend deferred explicitly by user; no integration or real model API calls
event_provenance: target event labels from existing project selection; source event identities unavailable

matrix.G1: existing source-only frozen models on two new series; no fitting
matrix.G2: per-map nested leave-one-series-out; >=3 series per map, one cyclic next series validation, rest training
matrix.G3: shared nested leave-one-series-out; cyclic next series validation, rest training
matrix.G4: leave-one-map-out; all series containing test-map excluded from training/validation, validation first remaining sorted series
matrix.G5: G4 plus one target-map support series (first sorted), testing remaining target-map series; source validation unchanged; no support siblings from other maps

training.loss: snapshot reconstruction + next-state masked MSE; equal weight
training.checkpoint: lowest validation next-state MSE; target tests not used
training.selection: training-only normalization; ridge penalty chosen only on fold validation; no target-driven routing; preserve every seed

statistics.aggregation: paired equal-series errors; report each map, horizon, component, death/equipment slice; three neural seeds averaged without target selection
statistics.intervals: 2000 paired series bootstrap, descriptive conditional on small shared-team cohort; not population significance
comparisons: G5 vs same G4 initialization/control on identical test rows

stopping: exactly two archives, at most six demos, no additional acquisition based on outcomes; no tuning after test results

claim_gates.state_transfer: positive equal-series improvement over persistence, per-map and per-series failures disclosed; interval crossing zero marked inconclusive
claim_gates.neural_advantage: positive paired advantage over strongest simple control with descriptive interval above zero; otherwise not established
claim_gates.tactics: cannot be certified by these proxy state targets or geometry; independent human review remains pending
